## Checks

- [ ] Added or updated self-contained synthetic tests.
- [ ] Ran relevant Python, Node and content-validation checks.
- [ ] Added source-located failure behaviour for malformed or unknown input.
- [ ] Did not attach, commit, link to or request game data, saves, screenshots or private reports.
- [ ] Checked upstream licence/provenance; updated `docs/provenance.md` if needed.
- [ ] Updated support/fidelity documentation.
- [ ] Added or updated the single `AdapterSpec` registration when adding an adapter.
- [ ] Left `gui_game_id` unset unless maintainers approved browser-playable support.
